leg-press.name: Leg press
leg-press.cue: Feet mid-platform, knees track over toes

goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet-squat.cue: Elbows inside the knees, chest tall

back-squat.name: Back squat, bar on upper back
back-squat.cue: Hands wide so the shoulders aren't pulled back; chest tall

dumbbell-squat.name: Dumbbell squat
dumbbell-squat.cue: Dumbbells hang at your sides, neutral grip; chest tall

bulgarian-split-squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian-split-squat.cue: Dumbbells at your sides, never front-racked. Start light

reverse-lunge.name: Reverse lunge
reverse-lunge.cue: Step back, not forward; dumbbells at your sides

step-up.name: Step-up, knee-height box
step-up.cue: Drive through the working leg, don't push off the trailing foot

seated-leg-curl.name: Seated leg curl
seated-leg-curl.cue: Slow on the way back, 3 seconds

dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.cue: Hips back, soft knees, neutral grip

prone-leg-curl.name: Prone leg curl
prone-leg-curl.cue: Hips stay pressed into the pad; slow on the way back

hip-thrust.name: Hip thrust
hip-thrust.cue: Chin tucked, ribs down; don't arch the lower back at the top

back-extension-45.name: 45° back extension
back-extension-45.cue: Hinge at the hips, not the lower back

hip-abduction-machine.name: Hip abduction machine
hip-abduction-machine.cue: Sit tall, hands on the side handles; push the knees out, slow on the way back

hip-adduction-machine.name: Hip adduction machine
hip-adduction-machine.cue: Start at a comfortable stretch, not a forced one; squeeze the knees together, slow on the way back

dumbbell-floor-press.name: Dumbbell floor press, neutral grip
dumbbell-floor-press.cue: Upper arms rest on floor briefly each rep

machine-chest-press.name: Machine chest press
machine-chest-press.cue: Stop when elbows reach torso level

flat-dumbbell-press.name: Flat dumbbell press, partial depth
flat-dumbbell-press.cue: Stop at torso level, never let elbows drop below

elevated-push-up.name: Elevated-hands push-up
elevated-push-up.cue: Hands on a bench or low bar; lower only until the elbows reach torso level, chest stays off the bench

standing-cable-press.name: Standing cable chest press
standing-cable-press.cue: Handles start level with your chest, elbows never behind the torso; press straight forward

pec-fly-machine.name: Pec fly machine, limited range
pec-fly-machine.cue: Set the handles so they start in front of the chest; the arms never open behind the torso

neutral-grip-lat-pulldown.name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
neutral-grip-lat-pulldown.cue: Elbows to ribs, don't drive them behind you

chest-down-dumbbell-row.name: Chest-down dumbbell row, 30–45° incline bench
chest-down-dumbbell-row.cue: Chest stays on the bench; elbow stops at the ribs

seated-cable-row.name: Seated cable row, neutral grip
seated-cable-row.cue: Chest up, elbows stop at the ribs

half-kneeling-cable-row.name: Half-kneeling single-arm cable row
half-kneeling-cable-row.cue: Elbow stops at the ribs, same as the other rows

diverging-lat-pulldown.name: Diverging lat pulldown machine
diverging-lat-pulldown.cue: Neutral handles, never palms up; elbows to ribs, don't drive them behind you

machine-seated-row.name: Seated row machine
machine-seated-row.cue: Chest on the pad, neutral handles; elbows stop at the ribs

diverging-seated-row.name: Diverging seated row machine
diverging-seated-row.cue: Chest on the pad, upper handles at shoulder height; elbows stop at the ribs

close-grip-floor-press.name: Close-grip floor press
close-grip-floor-press.cue: Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked in, dumbbells angled slightly toward each other

machine-triceps-extension.name: Machine triceps extension
machine-triceps-extension.cue: Elbows fixed, don't let them drift

dumbbell-kickback.name: Dumbbell kickback
dumbbell-kickback.cue: Upper arm parallel to the floor, only the forearm moves

cable-external-rotation.name: Cable external rotation, elbow at side
cable-external-rotation.cue: Elbow pinned to the ribs, only the forearm moves

rear-delt-fly.name: Chest-supported rear delt fly
rear-delt-fly.cue: Incline bench 30–45°, arms hang then arc out to the sides

rear-delt-fly-machine.name: Rear delt fly machine
rear-delt-fly-machine.cue: Light. Chest on the pad; arms open until level with the body, no further

band-pull-apart.name: Band pull-apart
band-pull-apart.cue: Arms straight, pull the band apart at chest height

prone-y-t-raise.name: Prone Y and T raise, very light
prone-y-t-raise.cue: Thumbs up on the Y, arms straight out to the sides on the T

cable-chop.name: Cable chop / lift
cable-chop.cue: Arms stay in front, rotate from the torso

plank.name: Plank
plank.cue: Reps are seconds held. Ribs down, don't let the hips sag

dead-bug.name: Dead bug
dead-bug.cue: Lower back stays flat against the floor

ab-roller.name: Ab roller, kneeling, partial range
ab-roller.cue: Stop when arms reach shoulder height, build range slowly

side-plank.name: Side plank
side-plank.cue: Reps are seconds held, per side. Hips stacked, don't rotate forward or back

suitcase-carry.name: Suitcase carry
suitcase-carry.cue: Reps are seconds walked, per side. Same weight in each hand; shoulders level, don't lean

knee-raise.name: Knee raise, power tower
knee-raise.cue: Arms supported, curl the pelvis, don't swing

cable-crunch.name: Cable crunch
cable-crunch.cue: Hands stay by your head, arms don't move; curl from the ribs, not the hips

leg-press-calf-raise.name: Calf raise on the leg press
leg-press-calf-raise.cue: Balls of the feet on the platform's bottom edge, knees straight; full stretch at the bottom

single-leg-calf-raise.name: Single-leg calf raise on a step
single-leg-calf-raise.cue: Dumbbell in the hand on the working leg's side, the other hand steadies; heel drops below the step
